references: docs/design/25-统一主体库与创作引用设计.md (SUB-017/018)
Parent-provided live date evidence: separate start/end; end defaults today; selecting day applies immediately; main menu remains open; no apply/cancel explanatory block.
changes: Removed all Active date range rows; topbar date label and clear control now own active-date presentation.

Reused ten search-state frames, moved existing inputs inline, removed six search modal/scrim pairs, connected pending samples with 300ms timer, disabled sort and displayed created metadata in nonempty search states.
Kept existing four calendar frames; replaced apply/cancel sequence with separate start/end controls, immediate date-cell actions and main menu backdrop.
Batch favorite now sets favorite state and returns to normal list; mobile batch filter destinations corrected; mobile batch mode retains the favorite star and suppresses only the more menu.
Existing settings family now has scrollable Body, header and footer outside Body, right-side supplemental reference column. Ordinary close remains direct; unknown task recovery retained.
Added eight phone size variants within existing Subject/Settings family and replaced ten existing phone instances; all reviewed phone actions are >=44px and audio row fits310px.
Removed source capability text; existing image/video source content is internally scrollable, source scrims have no dismissal reaction; empty selection counters and disabled confirmation preserved.
Updated existing interaction specification in place with debounce/IME/runtime boundary and same-type cross-group ID-based selection contract.

recovery: One list transport interruption was read back and showed no mutation before retry.
An instance overflow override rejection was corrected by keeping scroll ownership on main components or local source viewport wrappers.
Invalid prototype self-navigation was removed before successful retry.
The mobile-variant mutation returned transport closed but persisted; subsequent read recovered exact variant and descendant IDs instead of replaying the creation.
limitations: Figma uses fixed sample inputs and a300ms transition; free text, IME, network cancellation and arbitrary dates require browser/runtime tests.

Source designs remain the observed empty-state data. Multi-selection count and same-type cross-group preservation are recorded in existing interaction specification, not executed with invented selectable assets; real second batch and cross-group selection were not proven by this Figma work.
Calendar examples remain October/November2026 sample frames, not a full live calendar engine. End-label default is26-10-29 in the sample.
Download remains a browser/runtime operation; no fictitious downloaded artifact or successful receipt was added to prototype.
No specific-name deletion list was added because fresh competitor evidence excludes it.
No code or Git operations were performed by this design subtask.
